mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, it is 41 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and we are currently in the Third Quarter moon phase.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona, a time to honor our Planning and Development Department for their dedication to our community's future. Also, keep an eye out for potential mail regarding cross connection control surveys to ensure our water supply remains clean.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a variety of trivia events at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, and later this week look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market and live music at Paddy Mac's.
On September 24, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicyclist crash involving an 11-year-old child; thankfully, no hospital transport was required for the minor injuries.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and the Verona Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM.
